title: Nanocluster superstructures assembled via surface ligand switching at high temperature

synthesis.procedure: Prepare the ceria nanocluster superstructures from cerium acetate, benzyl ether and oleic acid under flowing nitrogen, then wash them and disperse them in minimal pyridine. Filter the resulting solution, add deionized water and acetonitrile, and leave it undisturbed to grow single crystals.
synthesis.temperature: 150 °C for the purge, then 290 °C for reflux; crystallization after cooling to room temperature
synthesis.time: 1 h at 150 °C; at least 4 h at 290 °C; at least 4 weeks for crystal growth
synthesis.vessel_or_method: One-pot colloidal reflux followed by crystallization from a filtered pyridine solution
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Cool to room temperature, wash by centrifugation with isopropanol and disperse in hexane at least twice. Disperse washed superstructures in minimal pyridine, pass through a 0.45 μm filter, add water and acetonitrile, and leave undisturbed.

source_locations.location: Results and discussion, single-crystal discussion; Fig. 2g and Supplementary Fig. 10 as cited in the main article
Supplied original cluster_complex catalog row ZIMTOI

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: The single-crystal structure contains a discrete Ce24O28(OH)8 core ligated by 30 benzoates and eight pyridine-derived species; the article describes four as OH-bound and four as cerium-bound. Disordered lattice solvent was treated by PLATON SQUEEZE.

synthesis.procedure: Heat cerium acetate, oleic acid and benzyl ether under flowing nitrogen to purge water and impurities, then reflux at 290 °C to form the nanocluster superstructure. Cool and wash the product by centrifugation.
synthesis.time: 1 h at 150 °C; at least 4 h at 290 °C
synthesis.vessel_or_method: One-pot colloidal reflux under flowing nitrogen
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Cool to room temperature; wash by centrifugation with isopropanol and disperse in hexane at least twice.
synthesis.yield: Approximately 4.3 g in a separately described scaled reaction using 400 ml of solvent

properties.summary: Ultraviolet–visible analysis found less visible-light absorbance after oleic-acid-induced disassembly than in the assembled ceria superstructure.

measurements.name: visible-light absorbance change upon disassembly
measurements.conditions: Hexane dispersions measured by ultraviolet–visible spectrophotometry, with and without added oleic acid

source_locations.location: OA-to-BA ligand switching for superstructure formation; Methods, Ultraviolet–visible measurements

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: Benzoate-capped Ce24O28(OH)8 nanoclusters assemble into rod-like superstructures. SAXS assigns a body-centred tetragonal arrangement; the article estimates about 30 bound benzoates and eight nonbinding benzyl ether molecules per cluster in the solution-phase assembly. This is distinct from the pyridine-containing single crystal.

synthesis.time: 1 h at 150 °C; at least 4 h at 290 °C
synthesis.vessel_or_method: One-pot colloidal reflux under flowing nitrogen
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Cool to room temperature; wash by centrifugation with isopropanol and disperse in hexane at least twice.
